summary: Steel lookout with wooden steps in Giles County, Virginia, on Jefferson National Forest land per the register; 2017 visit found stairs and cab floor missing.

access.note: A gate about half a mile from the tower, then a rough Jeep trail; the register says a high-clearance four-wheel-drive vehicle is required (2017 visit report). Land status is disputed between sources.

visit.trail_note: Bottom two flights of stairs and the cab floor were missing at the January 2017 register visit; a visitor listing calls the climb sketchy and dangerous.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey description places a survey mark at the site of Butt Mountain Lookout Tower No. 59 and says the mark is on the property of two private landowners
Registered March 14, 2014; nominated by Wes Alvin
Register visit report dated January 3, 2017: stairs and cab floor missing, cab holed, windows missing

evidence.quote: Butt Mountain Lookout is a steel tower with wooden steps.

evidence.supports: poor condition, cab floor rotted out, bottom flights of stairs removed
evidence.quote: The tower is currently in poor condition, with the cab floor rotted out and the bottom flights of stairs removed.

evidence.supports: 2017 visit report findings: stairs, cab floor, windows, holes
evidence.quote: Missing the bottom two flights of stairs. Numerous holes in cab from guns & bb guns. All windows missing. Cab floor missing.

evidence.supports: gate half a mile away, Jeep trail, 4WD required
evidence.quote: Gate 1/2 mile from tower. Vigorous Jeep trail to get to tower. A high clearance 4WD vehicle is required.
DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1964 (ELH)

evidence.supports: site of Butt Mountain Lookout Tower No. 59
survey mark on property of two private landowners
evidence.quote: THE STATION IS LOCATED ON THE PROPERTY OF MR. BILL JAMISON AND MRS. HAROLD KIRK

evidence.supports: rough road, Jeep, truck or SUV suggested
evidence.quote: Due to the rough road conditions, it is highly suggested to take a Jeep, truck, or SUV up the road.
The climb up the tower is sketchy and dangerous, so be certain that you are in good condition to climb up.
Butt Mountain Giles 37.36917 -80.62310 Tower Standing NHLR US 997, VA 11

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says Jefferson National Forest administers the site. The 1964 survey description places the survey mark on the property of two private landowners. The sources do not say which is current, so ownership is unresolved.

notes_for_editor: The 2017 visit report is nine years old; condition may have changed. Land ownership is unresolved: the register says Jefferson National Forest, the 1964 survey description says private property. No build date or builder found. The Tower No. 59 number appears only in the 1964 description. The visitor listing is user-written and its route may be out of date. Recommend the Forest Service (Jefferson National Forest) confirm the land status and current condition before publishing the access note.
